lines.text: A bag of apples weighs 250 pounds on Earth. Gravity on Neptune is 1.12 times Earth's. How much does it weigh on Neptune? Type the pounds.
Count out from the Sun. Fly to the seventh planet!
Fly to the planet farthest from the Sun!
If the Sun were a basketball, how big would Earth be?
Mystery planet! My year is only 88 days long. I am the smallest planet. Who am I?
Which is smaller, the Moon or Mars?
Why does the Sun look so much bigger than the other stars?
You jump 1 foot high on Earth. About how high on Mars?
